title: Improved Bounds for Unavoidable Claws in Tournaments
summary: Let $u(n)$ be the largest integer $d$ such that every $n$-vertex claw with at most $d$ branches occurs in every tournament on $n$ vertices, and let $c_{\mathrm{claw}}=\limsup_{n\to\infty}u(n)/n$. In 1998, Lu, Wang and Wong proved that $19/50\le c_{\mathrm{claw}}\le11/23$, and these have remained the best bounds known. We improve them to $2/5\le c_{\mathrm{claw}}\le10/21$.
